title: How Many Apples Can You Put into the Basket
summary: Given an array of apple weights, determine the greatest number of apples that can be placed in a basket with a 5000-unit weight capacity.
statement: Given an array of apple weights, determine the greatest number of apples that can be placed in a basket with a 5000-unit weight capacity.
constraints: Every apple may be chosen at most once.
hints: To maximize count under one capacity, lighter apples always dominate heavier ones.
Sort weights ascending and add them in that order.
Stop when the next apple would exceed 5000.
Any same-size selection has at least the prefix weight, so no larger feasible count was skipped.
